pages.title: At Home in the Snow
pages.text: Tame a baby Frostomper or a Speartooth through its native procedure.

pages.title: At Home in the Snow
pages.text: Hearty chops supply another cold journey and shaggy blocks help furnish winter housing.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use the baby Frostomper’s native taming route and avoid provoking adult herds. Speartooth takes Beast Chops; a single feeding is not guaranteed success.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Defeat a Frostomper and collect its meat. The large mammoth supplies Beast Chops.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Tame a baby Frostomper rather than challenging an adult herd. The guide offers a combat companion route while adults use ice powers and provide hunting loot.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Offer Beast Chops while working toward taming a Speartooth. The guide identifies its food and pack ambush/chase behavior; the native advancement confirms taming is a real progression goal without proving its exact chance.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Craft all three Ice Cream types and a full Frostbite armor set. Native milestones separate cooking collection from protective equipment progression.
